item_short_desc: Wear your rank with Rothco’s 2nd Lieutenant Insignia.
description: Wear your rank with Rothco’s 2nd Lieutenant Insignia. This military insignia is constructed with a professional 22k plated gold, and is secured by a push pin backing for easy attachment to your uniform. This Air Force Insignia is manufactured by a United States factory that is certified by The Institute of Heraldry. This army insignia is packaged in a set of two.
